standard.summary: 每 N 个 DiT block 设一个检查点。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Place one checkpoint every N DiT blocks.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default, then short-test a few steps before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is on at the same time.

advanced.principle: 每 N 个 DiT block 设一个检查点。1 = 全部重算最省显存；2-4 显存略高但更快。

advanced_en.principle: Place a checkpoint every N DiT blocks. 1 = recompute everything, most VRAM-friendly; 2-4 uses a bit more VRAM but runs faster.
